He changed what it meant to be an NFL reporter, rising the ranks from beat writer covering the Cincinnati Bengals in the 1980s to one of the most well-known, widely read and influential national writers. In advance of the release of his latest book, "The Game," he sat down with Robert Mays to dive deep into his treasure trove of stories from 40 years of covering the NFL. Join The Athletic Football Show Discord Server: https://discord.gg/theathleticfootballshow Host: Robert Mays With: Peter King Executive Producer: Michael Beller Senior Producer: Katy Duffy Social Producer: Scott Krinch Theme song: Haunted Written by Dylan Slocum, Trevor Dietrich, Ruben Duarte, Kyle McAulay, and Meredith VanWoert / Performed by Spanish Love Songs Courtesy of Pure Noise / By arrangement with Bank Robber Music, LLC Hosted on Acast. title: What’s WRONG with Bo Nix? NFL Insider James Palmer on Broncos vs. Seahawks! | Orange & Blue Today
text: Description: 🔥 THE BRONCOS HAVE A HUGE THURSDAY NIGHT TEST — AND WE’RE GOING INSIDE THE MATCHUP! Cecil Lammey and Andrew Mason welcome James Palmer, NFL Insider for Amazon Prime , to Orange & Blue Today to break down the Denver Broncos ahead of their showdown with the Seattle Seahawks! 💥 WHAT’S WRONG WITH BO NIX? The Broncos QB has struggled. What’s behind the issues, and can Nix get things turned around against Seattle? 💥 HOW DOES THE BRONCOS OFFENSE RESPOND? Denver got the win against the Chargers, but the offense still has questions to answer. What needs to change before Thursday Night Football? 💥 HOW DO YOU SLOW DOWN JAXON SMITH-NJIGBA? Seattle’s superstar wide receiver presents a major challenge. How can Denver’s defense contain JSN and slow down the Seahawks passing game? 💥 A HUGE THURSDAY NIGHT SHOWDOWN! With the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks coming to Denver, what are the biggest keys for the Broncos to pull off a statement win? 🎙️ Cecil Lammey and Andrew Mason talk Broncos with James Palmer on Orange & Blue Today! ZB has his patented ZB3 in which he reviews the Eagles' game-management decisions, Jalen Hurts's calf update, and when Landon Dickerson could possibly return. What will we be discussing if the Eagles win or lose? Anthony Dabbundo then joins the show to discuss the Phillies giving interim manager Don Mattingly a two-year deal. Plus, the mailbag! title: [FULL EPISODE] The Athletic's Josh Kendall gives us a look at the Falcons!
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer is joined by Josh Kendall, who covers the Falcons for The Athletic. Kendall tells us everything we need to know about Atlanta. How good does he think the Falcons truly are? What makes running back Bijan Robinson so special? And what's the weakness of the Falcons' defense?

title: Bears will be without Montez Sweat for 2 games
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote react to the news that Bears defensive end Montez Sweat has been suspended for two games for violating the NFL's policy on performance-enhancing substances.

title: Is Tyson Bagent still the 2nd-best QB on the Bears?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote discuss the Bears' quarterback situation. If Caleb Williams can't return against the Falcons on Sunday, should it be Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum starting?

title: What's wrong with Jaylon Johnson?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote examine Bears cornerback Jaylon Johnson's performance. Will he ever get back to the star play we've seen in the past?
